sections.Profile:
"Ramona" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by United Manufacturing Company in February 1949. The game features two flippers, six passive bumpers, and five kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: United Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
